## P-S3-1 Property source stream

Every property derives from the causal RESIDUAL stream of each
color-transformed plane (YCoCg-R production order, MED predictor shipped -
S1 verdict), walked in raster order. The decoder mirrors from decoded
history alone; lossless reversibility makes encoder and decoder histories
identical (I2). Per-plane hasher state; fresh state per plane.

## P-S3-2 Quotient buckets qW/qN/qNW/qNE

Production quantization `quant_residual()` (values 0..6) of the neighbor
residuals: W = res[i-1], N = res[i-w], NW = res[i-w-1], NE = res[i-w+1];
missing primaries read 0 (production border rule). qW/qN/qNW coincide with
the production context components (L/U/UL); qNE is new information beyond
the 343-context id. Octile edges per P-S3-6.

## P-S3-3 Gradient magnitude buckets gbW/gbN

The amendment-A4 CALIC gradient pair evaluated ON THE RESIDUAL STREAM with
P-S1-2 neighbor derivation:

    dh = |W-WW| + |N-NW| + |NE-N|
    dv = |NW-W| + |N-NN| + |N-NE|

gbW = bias_bucket(dh, bd_shift), gbN = bias_bucket(dv, bd_shift), where
bd_shift = bd - 8 (0 at BD8) and bias_bucket is the shared harness
function (thresholds {0,1,2,4,8,16,32} << shift strictly below |g|,
capped 7; values 0..7). Fixed buckets; NO octiles on these coordinates.

## P-S3-4 Plane id

Raw plane index within the transformed raster's plane order (0-based).
Fixed coordinate; no octiles.

## P-S3-5 e_max_prev bucket

Per 18.4 verbatim: the PREVIOUS sample's max sub-predictor error. Under
the S1 contract MED ships alone, so e_max_prev = |res[i-1]| (0 at i == 0),
bucketed by the literal 18.4 edge table
[0],[1],[2],[3],[4-5],[6-7],[8-11],[12-15],[16-23],[24-31],[32-63],[64+]
(values 0..11). Fixed buckets; no octiles; no BD scaling (verbatim text;
a BD16 reading would require a numbered amendment).

## P-S3-6 Octile edges (causal, prefix-invariant)

Enabled quotient coordinates only. Each keeps per-plane exact counts over
values 0..6 of samples ALREADY SEEN in that plane. At sample i the edge
set is computed from counts over samples [0, i) exclusively: edge k
(k = 1..7) = smallest value v whose cumulative count reaches k/8 of the
total, evaluated exactly as cum*8 >= total*k, deduplicated ascending.
Assignment of sample i therefore never depends on sample j > i
(prefix-invariance; pinned unit test). Bucket of value v =
#{deduped edges <= v} (range 0..7; a new minimum buckets to 0). First
sample of a plane sees empty histograms: every quotient bucket reads 0.

## P-S3-7 Flat hash mixer

FNV-1a word variant, 32-bit: h = 2166136261u; for each ENABLED coordinate
in the pinned order (qW, qN, qNW, qNE, gbW, gbN, plane, emax - the 19.4
listing order): h = (h ^ value) * 16777619u mod 2^32. Disabled
coordinates are SKIPPED entirely (they contribute neither a mix step nor a
zero). Raw cluster = h mod k_raw.

## P-S3-8 Variants and K axis (pre-named; no post-hoc additions)

    SX-FULL  {qW,qN,qNW,qNE,gbW,gbN,plane,emax}
    SX-Q     {qW,qN,qNW,qNE}
    SX-G     {qW,qN,gbW,gbN}
    SX-E     {qW,qN,qNW,qNE,emax}

each crossed with k_raw in {64, 256}; caps/floors inherited (K_MAX = 256,
4096-sample floor via apply_cluster_budget, 'SBP1' merge map NETTED;
decoders mirror count-based merges exactly). NO spatial maps, NO trees
anywhere in S3: the only transmitted artifacts are tables + the 'SBP1'
byte string (trees column = 0 forever in this phase).

## P-S3-9 Frames, baseline, gate reading

Variants score FRAME-S ONLY (blueprint scope note: extended properties
have no trivially available FRAME-A scoring; never gating). Baseline =
same-stack best-flat-16 control: ZFFCTRL x KFLAT16 x MED stream,
budget-enforced, fully NETTED, measured fresh in the same run (B-IDEAL
reference + B-RANS gating rows, the s1 FRAME-S MED flow unchanged).
RELPCT(variant) = 100 * (net_base - net_variant) / net_base per image on
joint NET bytes (I12); quad MEDIAN primary (I10), min/max reported.
S3 PASS iff the best variant median >= +1.50 pct in FRAME-S; FAIL =>
flat-16 ships and bucket B2 closes with numbers (addendum 19.5 verbatim).
Gate/verdict lines never flip exit codes; VB-* rail failures DO.

## P-S3-10 CSV schema and anchors

`benchmarks/results/YYYY-MM-DD-sandbox-s3.csv` per 19.6. Variant rows:

    S3,img,frame,variant,kraw,backend,payload,tables,maps,trees,net,audit,rt,tbl_bits

frame in {S}; variant in {KFLAT16,SX-FULL,SX-Q,SX-G,SX-E}; backend in
{B-IDEAL,B-RANS}. Every --s3 run ALSO re-emits the SANDBOX ZFFCTRL/
B-ADAPT/KPROD control row, the BRACKET frozen-walk row, and the B-IDEAL
anchor trio (KSHARED/KFLAT16/KFLAT343, enforcement-exempt), so
VB-anchor-adapt and VB-anchor-ideal guard every measurement against the
committed references exactly as in V0/V1/s1 modes.

## P-S3-11 Decoder mirroring (binding test)

Encode-side events are tagged through the live hasher; the decode side
runs a FRESH hasher over its growing decoded history and must reproduce
identical cluster sequences. Pinned unit test: encode with the hasher
ClusterMap, decode with a fresh-hasher ClusterMap, residuals match
byte-for-byte; determinism and prefix-invariance tests join it.

## P-S3-12 Wall-clock

A3 precedent stands: structural instrument multipliers are logged beside
every phase; NO gate depends on wall-clock.
